name: Blood Tears

stealth.details: (master) to notice your vision tint red

disable: DC 30 Diplomacy check (master) to talk the spirit out of gouging its eyes or DC 32 Religion check (trained) to ease the spirit's sorrows

items.name: Weep Blood
items.text:
Trigger A creature approaches within 15 feet

---

Effect Blood seeps from the eyes of all creatures within 30 feet, dealing persistent bleed damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 33 Fortitude save save.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d8+3 bleed damage and is Dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes 4d8+6 bleed damage and is dazzled for as long as the persistent damage lasts.

Critical Failure The creature takes 8d8+12 bleed damage and is Blinded for as long as the persistent damage lasts.

text: A wailing spirit appears and gouges their own eyes. As they do, blood seeps from the eyes of those who witness the act, obscuring their vision.
